Synopsis:
These paladins signed their pact with Zariel for riches and power and serve her with relish. They've agreed to capture and kill Karlach, one of the origin characters.

This cultist is the leader of the group. He's friendly, but badly injured after his fight with Karlach.

context: These paladins are zealots who swore themselves to the archdevil Zariel for power and riches and have agreed to capture and kill Karlach, an origin-character fugitive. Their leader, Anders, is present but badly wounded from a recent fight with Karlach; despite his injuries he speaks amicably and urges others to “chase down the fiend.” Off‑screen the area is tense — the Emerald Grove has seen goblin attacks, tiefling refugees, and druids preparing a ritual — so other familiar figures or scavenged intelligence may already be involved. The narrator’s note that devils collect souls through cunning rather than slaughter suggests the enemy may act by guile, and the player’s offer to help can lead into a pursuit or draw them deeper into the Grove’s wider conflicts and moral choices.
